diversityGuidelines.skinTones: Use varied representation: fair, light-medium, medium, medium-dark, deep, rich brown
diversityGuidelines.bodyTypes: Include diverse builds: slim, athletic, fit, lean, muscular, curvy, plus-size, average
diversityGuidelines.ageRange: Represent all demographics: early 20s (youth), late 20s-early 30s (prime), mid 30s-40s (mature), 45+ (distinguished)
diversityGuidelines.ethnicFeatures: Specify when helpful: Asian, African, European, Latin, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, mixed heritage
diversityGuidelines.gender: Include: men, women, nonbinary, gender-fluid presentations
diversityGuidelines.accessibility: Consider: different abilities, adaptive fashion needs
